candidates.title: Legacy decommissioning and migration benefit assurance
candidates.problem: Reported simplification priorities need dependency-aware sequencing and benefit validation.
candidates.intervention: Assess application dependencies, decommissioning readiness, service risks and benefit ownership.
candidates.programme_signal: Management priority; named programme scope unverified
candidates.ranking_change: Sharpens the broad control-tower hypothesis into an enterprise-specific migration question; not a funded programme.

candidates.title: AI value realisation and operating controls
candidates.problem: Reported use cases and claimed value do not establish net outcomes after adoption and control costs.
candidates.intervention: Validate benefit baselines, service workflows, operational controls and measured adoption.
candidates.programme_signal: Reported use-case rollout; work packages/buyers unverified
candidates.ranking_change: Separates company-reported benefit and forward expectation from confirmed supplier spend.

candidates.title: Brand/app migration customer-outcome assurance
candidates.problem: A reported Halifax/Lloyds change creates testable migration, confusion and service-outcome questions.
candidates.intervention: Investigate customer journey mapping, migration communication, vulnerable-customer safeguards and outcome measurement.
candidates.programme_signal: Reported announcement; current implementation status unverified
candidates.ranking_change: Replaces a generic outsourcing framing with a specific outcome-validation question; outsourcing workshare remains unknown.

candidates.title: AI model-platform governance and lineage
candidates.problem: Reported Vertex AI/model migrations motivate model inventory, lineage and control questions.
candidates.intervention: Explore model lifecycle controls, lineage, accountability and platform transition evidence.
candidates.programme_signal: Reported platform use; delivery/sourcing scope unverified
candidates.ranking_change: Narrows a broad AI/cloud hypothesis; does not infer Google exclusivity or a new procurement.

candidates.title: Critical-service third-party dependency and exit assurance
candidates.problem: Reported supplier/technology risks require enterprise-specific service and exit mapping before a proposition.
candidates.intervention: Investigate critical-service dependencies, control responsibilities, exit testing and resilience evidence.
candidates.programme_signal: Risk-disclosure signal; no programme announcement established
candidates.ranking_change: Creates a bounded risk-led discovery question; industry provider designation is not a Lloyds contract or finding.

candidates.title: Deposit/customer-value and balance-sheet analytics
candidates.problem: Reported franchise/hedge economics need customer-behaviour and elasticity evidence.
candidates.intervention: Explore segment retention, customer primacy, pricing sensitivity and treasury/customer-value data linkage.
candidates.programme_signal: Economic mechanism; no named buying programme
candidates.ranking_change: Economic relevance is strengthened, but customer primacy, spend and timing remain unproven.

candidates.title: Assisted-access service and vulnerability outcomes
candidates.problem: Local channel changes require evidence of service continuity and vulnerable-customer outcomes.
candidates.intervention: Investigate access assessments, assisted/digital hand-offs and outcome monitoring before shaping service scope.
candidates.programme_signal: Local assessment signal; current location-level work unknown
candidates.ranking_change: Refocuses channel/service work on evidenced constraints, not an assumed BPO contract.

candidates.title: Colleague AI adoption and productivity controls
candidates.problem: Licence counts and an AI Academy direction do not establish adoption or realised net productivity.
candidates.intervention: Investigate role-based adoption, colleague workflows, control burden and measured benefits.
candidates.programme_signal: Reported enablement signal; current scope unverified
candidates.ranking_change: Separates workforce adoption from platform governance while flagging overlap; no additive deal values.

watchlist.reason: Industry relevance does not establish Lloyds-specific control failure, outsourcing footprint or a buying trigger.

gaps.title: Current primary verification
gaps.question: Which claims are supported by the latest original publications?
gaps.required_evidence: Retrieve and quote-locate current Lloyds annual, interim and latest trading updates; capture publication dates, periods and content hashes.
gaps.decision_impact: All current factual confidence and programme status.
gaps.owner_role: Research owner / account team; named owner not established

gaps.title: Customer buying evidence
gaps.question: Is there a customer-acknowledged problem and a funded decision process?
gaps.required_evidence: Customer meeting/requirement reference; economic buyer, funding, criteria, process, relationship and mutual next action.
gaps.decision_impact: Commercial qualification and pursuit; no public-source ranking can replace this.
gaps.owner_role: Research owner / account team; named owner not established

gaps.title: Regulatory applicability
gaps.question: Which current versions, effective dates and entities are in scope?
gaps.required_evidence: Retrieve FCA Consumer Duty/resilience publications, PRA/BoE rules and HM Treasury designations.
gaps.decision_impact: Do not infer compliance failure or mandatory procurement.
gaps.owner_role: Research owner / account team; named owner not established

gaps.title: Investment allocation
gaps.question: Which investment capacity is allocated to external addressable work?
gaps.required_evidence: Approved programme funding and sourcing scope, distinguishing gross savings, benefits and supplier spend.
gaps.decision_impact: Value and commercial addressability remain Unknown.
gaps.owner_role: Research owner / account team; named owner not established

gaps.title: Channel/customer outcomes
gaps.question: What is the impact of brand/app and branch changes?
gaps.required_evidence: Current local access assessments, complaints, vulnerable-customer outcomes, retention and customer journey measures.
gaps.owner_role: Research owner / account team; named owner not established

gaps.title: Deposit and relationship behaviour
gaps.question: Are digital users primary customers and what is deposit elasticity?
gaps.required_evidence: Salary-flow/direct-debit concentration, retention, deposit segment and pricing behaviour.
gaps.owner_role: Research owner / account team; named owner not established

gaps.title: Programme and workload scope
gaps.question: Which workloads/capabilities have funded migration or control work?
gaps.required_evidence: Approved roadmap, application dependencies, critical-service mapping, ownership and procurement evidence.
gaps.owner_role: Research owner / account team; named owner not established

gaps.title: Net AI benefits
gaps.question: Are claimed benefits realised net of adoption/control costs?
gaps.required_evidence: Benefit baselines, adoption measures, control costs and benefit ownership; distinguish targets from realised results.
gaps.owner_role: Research owner / account team; named owner not established

gaps.title: Supplier contracts and roles
gaps.question: What is the actual supplier workshare, obligation and renewal/exit position?
gaps.required_evidence: Current customer or supplier primary disclosure, contract scope and terms where authorised.
gaps.decision_impact: Do not infer exclusivity, BPO footprint, renewal or displacement.
gaps.owner_role: Research owner / account team; named owner not established

gaps.title: Transaction and integration status
gaps.question: Did the proposed Curve transaction complete, and what integration is approved?
gaps.required_evidence: Completion announcement and customer-approved integration roadmap.
gaps.owner_role: Research owner / account team; named owner not established

gaps.title: Lloyds-specific fraud evidence
gaps.question: Which fraud/control problem is material within Lloyds?
gaps.required_evidence: Lloyds-specific losses, reimbursement, false positives, complaints and funded response.
gaps.decision_impact: Fraud opportunity not admitted solely from industry statistics.
gaps.owner_role: Research owner / account team; named owner not established

gaps.title: Climate/transition materiality
gaps.question: Which Lloyds portfolios and programmes have material climate needs?
gaps.required_evidence: Latest primary sustainability/transition report, financed-emissions scope and portfolio materiality.
gaps.decision_impact: No climate proposition admitted without enterprise evidence.
gaps.owner_role: Research owner / account team; named owner not established

gaps.title: Market structure
gaps.question: What are the latest comparable market shares and entrant economics?
gaps.required_evidence: FCA/CMA and dated primary enterprise disclosures with consistent market/entity boundaries.
gaps.decision_impact: Porter assessments remain qualitative, not measured market power.
gaps.owner_role: Research owner / account team; named owner not established
